snapshot_envelope.payload_hash: sha256 of exact HTTP response bytes
snapshot_envelope.raw_payload_storage: base64 of exact HTTP response bytes, verified against payload_hash and parsed payload
snapshot_envelope.snapshot_hash: sha256 of canonical envelope before snapshot_sha256 and vintage_id

hashrate.qualification_use: current daily hashrate schema, unit, publication lag, and immutable lineage only
hashrate.replication_limitation: A present-day full-history download is not automatically eligible for 2020-2022; historical reserve requires explicit point-in-time availability and immutable fingerprints.

dxy.qualification_use: current DXY close schema and immutable daily snapshot only
dxy.replication_limitation: CSV history may be revised; decision timestamps must use completed prior-session closes with available_at no earlier than the next UTC midnight.

vix.qualification_use: current VIX close schema and immutable daily snapshot only
vix.replication_limitation: CSV history may be revised; decision timestamps must use completed prior-session closes with available_at no earlier than the next UTC midnight.

publication_lag_contract.hashrate: completed UTC-day network estimate must be available before the decision ts_event that consumes it
publication_lag_contract.dxy: previous completed session close; available_at >= next UTC midnight after session date
publication_lag_contract.vix: previous completed session close; available_at >= next UTC midnight after session date
